column1: # Stage S10 H3a, second Mission Creator crate: the editor's engine bridge (the boot machine, the
# frame-timing belt, the hosted document and its undo drive, the host state, the map overlays and
# the tactical-graphics belt) and its input layer (the canvas gestures, the window keydown
# dispatches and the browser half of the map tools) become the two top-level modules of
# helpers as its `test_support` module behind the dev-only `test_fixtures` feature. Each prefix
# is one `crate::` row per moved folder that names it and one `mission_creator_engine_bridge::`
# row scoped to the app's source.
